versos.e: 2. An inhabitant of Kirjath-jearim who tended the ark of the covenant for a while 1Sa 7:1,2
4. Son of Dodo, and one of David’s distinguished heroes 2Sa 23:9,10,13; 1Ch 11:12
.Married a daughter of Putiel, who bore him Phinehas Ex 6:25
.After the death of Nadab and Abihu is made chief of the tribe of Levi Nu 3:32
.Succeeds Aaron as high priest Nu 20:26,28; De 10:6
